interpretation: This is teacher-forced TRAIN-only fit analysis of one known SCRIPTED_SIM episode, not an independent success/generalization evaluation. 6904 overlapping target slots do not constitute independent episodes.

Within ABS representation both model overall normalized MAEs exceed causal HOLD. Within INCR representation both are below identical HOLD/ZERO; comparisons across representations are invalid because normalization and endpoint/increment meanings differ.

Residual phase/joint/gripper errors remain. INCR release gripper delta MAE is close to zero/hold baseline, while aggregate nine-channel MAE can hide sparse-motion errors. No error threshold is interpreted as grasp or full-task success.
Historical stochastic posterior/dropout minibatch losses are reported separately. No posterior is executed here, so these observations do not identify a causal latent-gap explanation.

Teacher forcing supplies recorded prior commands; no claim that these errors bound closed-loop drift or physical tracking. Single-example sampling, alias, representation, optimization and distribution remain unresolved questions.
No learned-source04/H2, physical, navigation, vision-causality, mastery, model-promotion or entire-master-completion claim.

loss_and_latent_definition_inspection.audit_metric: float64 accumulated masked absolute errors/(valid_action_slots*9), not a stochastic training-loss replay
loss_and_latent_definition_inspection.deployment: predict_action_chunk calls eval(); no action labels; latent=zeros[batch,16]; dropout disabled
loss_and_latent_definition_inspection.train: policy.train(); posterior(mu,sigma) consumes TRAIN future action labels and pad mask; samples using torch.randn_like; dropout active
